$comment: Names the PHP renderers emit without a matching frontend rule. `deliberate` entries are settled decisions and stay silent. `pendingReview` entries are reported on every run until someone either styles the name or moves it to `deliberate` with a reason. Remove an entry as soon as the frontend defines the name; the check fails on a stale entry so the list cannot rot.

deliberate.yii-debug-callout-muted: Muted is the neutral base: the four toned variants only override `border-left-color`, so muted needs no rule.
deliberate.yii-debug-gauge-value: Structural label for the readout inside a micro-gauge; the rail and the bar carry the styling.
deliberate.yii-debug-tab-content: Structural label for the container holding the tab panels; each panel carries the styling.

pendingReview.yii-debug-brand-chip-yii: Every sibling chip variant is styled; this one is not.
pendingReview.yii-debug-event-permalink: Permalink control of an event row.
pendingReview.yii-debug-event-phase: Phase marker of an event row.
pendingReview.yii-debug-header-exchange: Request and response header exchange shell.
pendingReview.yii-debug-header-exchange-body: Body of the header exchange shell.
pendingReview.yii-debug-header-exchange-title: Title of the header exchange shell.
pendingReview.yii-debug-indent: Depth indent of a profiling row.
pendingReview.yii-debug-main-bare: Shell variant rendering the page without the sidebar.
pendingReview.yii-debug-panel-title: Panel heading of the standalone snapshot view.
pendingReview.yii-debug-phpinfo-filter: Filter control of the PHP Info page.
pendingReview.yii-debug-phpinfo-results: Result region of the PHP Info filter.
pendingReview.yii-debug-route-match: Modifier marking the matched route badge.
pendingReview.yii-debug-route-trace-wrap: Scroll wrapper of the route trace table.
pendingReview.yii-debug-server-environment-title: Title of the server environment section.
pendingReview.yii-debug-snapshot-time: Time chip of the sidebar snapshot card.
pendingReview.yii-debug-tl-memory-gradient: Gradient fill of the timeline memory footer.
pendingReview.yii-debug-tl-row-: Timeline span category. The `--yii-debug-cat-*` tokens exist per category, but no rule maps the variant class to them, so every bar and dot renders in the database hue.
